title: Embedding accuracy playbook and drift watch for reranking
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a repeatable, production-ready evaluation harness and operational playbook for embedding accuracy and reranker quality that: (1) defines golden sets and labeling guidelines, (2) computes stable offline metrics with confidence intervals, (3) integrates latency/throughput probes for reranking endpoints, and (4) establishes drift detection and alerting for embedding distributions. The aim is to catch regressions before they reach customers, quantify quality/latency trade-offs for quantized/low-precision models, and provide automated nightly and canary checks that feed the Console and paging signals.
acceptance_criteria: Gold set with 10k human-labeled pairs stratified by domain (search, support, docs) and length buckets is stored in S3 and accessible to eval jobs
Baseline offline metrics (Recall@1/5/10, MRR, MAP, NDCG@10) computed nightly with bootstrapped 95% CIs
Drift detector produces weekly and daily signals (JS divergence on embedding clusters, norm shifts) and integrates with Alerting (PagerDuty) when thresholds exceeded
Latency regression harness produces p50/p95/p99 for reranker end-to-end request with and without batching for three representative fleets
Canary pipeline runs on every model rollout and blocks deploys when quality drops beyond configured rollback thresholds
Documentation and playbook published to Confluence and linked in the Console runbook for on-call
tasks: Define annotation schema and labeling instructions; recruit 3 SMEs for initial golden set
Build data sampling job to pull representative queries and candidates from production logs (privacy-filtered)
Implement offline evaluator that computes Recall@K, MRR, NDCG and returns bootstrapped CIs
Add synthetic perturbation generator (typos, paraphrase, stopword removal) for robustness checks
Wire nightly job to upload metrics to Grafana and Console-quality dashboard
Implement drift detector (JS divergence on cluster centroids, embedding-norm shifts, percentile changes) and set initial thresholds
Add reranker latency probes (vary batch sizes 1..32, sequence lengths) and run on Dedicated and Hosted fleets
Create canary gating job that runs on 1000 sample requests and enforces rollback criteria
evaluation_metrics: Recall@1, Recall@5, Recall@10: fraction of queries with relevant item in top-K
MRR: mean reciprocal rank of first relevant item
Pairwise AUC: for reranker pair classification tasks
Bootstrapped 95% CI: to detect statistically significant regressions
Embedding distribution metrics: mean L2 norm, JS divergence between daily and baseline, cluster centroid drift distance
dataset_plan: Golden set composition: 10k labeled query-candidate pairs across three domains (search, support-case, docs-retrieval), split 70/15/15 for train/val/test
Label schema: 0=irrelevant, 1=related, 2=fully relevant with instructions and examples for raters
Inter-rater reliability target: Cohen's kappa >= 0.7 on validation batch
Synthetic augmentations: paraphrase (back-translation), typos, truncation to stress short-context behavior
Storage: S3 bucket with manifest and metadata; versioned snapshots for reproducibility
monitoring_plan: Nightly job computes distribution stats and emits metrics to Grafana: embedding_mean_norm, embedding_std, js_divergence_baseline
Thresholds: JS divergence > 0.12 -> warning; > 0.20 -> critical and page on-call
Windowed comparisons: 24h vs baseline (30-day rolling median) and 7d trend slope alerts
Explainability hook: sample queries that drive drift and surface top-10 changed centroids in Console
Auto-run re-labeling workflow when drift persists for >3 consecutive days to refresh golden set candidates
performance_plan: Benchmark reranker p50/p95/p99 at batch sizes [1,4,8,16,32] on Dedicated GPU type A and Hosted fleet B
Record end-to-end latency (including embedding compute + reranker scoring) and isolate model-only vs infra overhead
Measure throughput (embeddings/sec) and memory/KV cache hit ratio under typical traffic traces
Run stress tests to understand autoscaling breakpoints and queueing behavior at peak QPS
Parameter sweep for quantization profiles (int8, q4f16) to find sweet spot between metric loss and latency gains
rollout_plan: Integrate harness with model rollout pipeline: pre-rollout canary (1k requests), post-rollout daily sampling (10k requests)
Canary gating: block if Recall@5 drop > 2% absolute or if p95 latency increases by 25%
Automatic fallback: wire policy to route a configurable fraction of traffic to previous model on detection of regression
Ops runbook: steps to triage, reproduce, and rollback; include responsible on-call and SME contacts
Stakeholder review: PM acceptance test and Design review for any UX-facing ranking changes
